dataset: Marshall Fire 2021 curated event timeline (Boulder County Everbridge release and Marshall Fire Operational AAR)
interpretation: Everbridge rows are the county's tabulated record of each launched notification (send time with seconds, message issue time as written in the message text, total contacts). They show messages launched to registered contact paths, not receipt, departure or compliance. AAR rows are a retrospective official timeline compiled from interviews and debriefs; times are clock minutes as written and describe when something was reported or done, not necessarily when a physical state began. Rows with time_precision 'day' are untimed narrative statements about December 30 and must not be treated as instants.
